evidence_goals: Acquire actual public historical local_timestamp samples, distinguish new OI events from forward-filled derivative ticker state
Match funding API exact millisecond times and decimal rates against frozen official ZIPs; count nonempty positive settlement marks without substituting hourly prices
Archive official and provider contract documentation; require complete effective-dated terms, not current exchangeInfo or unrelated quarterly contracts

gate_requirements.OI: Continuous independently evidenced historical available/event times, including preceding24h, for the entire frozen evaluation and source mapping/version provenance; isolated first-of-month samples cannot pass
gate_requirements.funding: All actual settlement events and exact positive settlement marks across the entire fixed evaluation, plus historically available rates for signal inputs
gate_requirements.terms: Complete relevant effective-dated identity, listing/termination, price/quantity filters, maintenance margin and settlement conditions for BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT USD-M perpetuals
gate_requirements.structure: Historical available timestamps and mapping for price/flow/mark/index inputs as required by unchanged protocol

acquisition_limits: Public unauthenticated documented samples only; no purchase/subscription, account access, order endpoints or rate-limit circumvention. Retain failures as evidence, not absence-of-existence proof.
normalization: Preserve original source bytes and capture times. Vendor local time is provider-reported historical receipt, not original exchange publication or timestamp authentication. CSV carried-forward OI timestamps cannot be treated as fresh observations.
decision: If any required continuous evidence is missing, NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE; no performance engine, PnL or control execution. Preserve prior reports. Only after all gates pass, implement and independently reproduce frozen strategy without rule/cost/period changes.
